cap: Each bacterial infection has one drug logic. Screening uses a NAAT because most infections are silent. Chlamydia is treated with doxycycline, gonorrhea with ceftriaxone, and pelvic inflammatory disease with ceftriaxone, doxycycline and metronidazole so that gonococci, chlamydia and anaerobes are all covered. Syphilis needs penicillin G even in pregnancy, by desensitization if allergic, and the first dose can cause a Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction.
